title: The Citizen Theatre Podcast
author: Citizen Theatre
description: Take a deep dive with Tomas Parrish into the people behind the magic at Citizen Theatre, with guests ranging from performers, designers, stage managers, and more. Unearth the beauty that lies behind all aspects of Citizen Theatre and its artists, and what moves them.

episodes_recents.titre: Now that the world likes me, what’s next?! - Margot Tanjutco
Behind the Visuals and Graphics - Stu Brown
Bold Offers! Judgement Free! - Freya Pragt and Jack Wunsch
